text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Vietnamese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Vietnam's new foreign investment law will come into effect from March 1.
-- Recent sharp hikes in the price of the US dollar have triggered concern among economists about the possible adverse impact of the domestic US dollar market on the national economy.
-- Several local authorities will be given the right to issue licences for foreign direct investment projects without having to inform the Ministry of Planning and Investment.
-- The Ministry of Industry says Vietnam should become a strong information technology service centre in Southeast Asia.
-- Vietnam's leaders have sent a message of condolence to their Chinese counterparts over the death of veteran Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping.
-- A 38-year-old man has been sentenced to death in the southern province of Dong Nai for trafficking in opium.
-- Vietnam announced new admendments to regulations on income tax on Thursday.
-- Vietnam Airlines and South Korea's Asiana Airlines have opened a cargo service between Seoul and Ho Chi Minh City.
